'''Soda''' was a beverage. It was one of the drinks served in [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> The drink was also advertised on the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] during the war.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
Having accepted a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], [[Melvin Fett]] went to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[Hunting/Legends|search]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]]. When the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] became [[Water/Legends|dehydrated]] during [[Gender/Legends|his]] hunt, Fett found a [[Senator Jar Jar Binks commemorative drinking cup]] filled with soda, and so consumed the beverage, sating his thirst.<ref name="Melvin Fett">{{Tales|20|Melvin Fett (comic story)}}</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}
